Two people, one Sikh and the other Atheist, were talking about whether they value trust in their relationships. The Atheist one places trust above all else and would never do anything to seem untrustworthy, but the Sikh one seems to always be the one breaking people's trust, usually without meaning to. Who is untrustworthy?
A. Not enough information
B. The Sikh one
C. The Atheist one
